description: INDEPENDENT ORACLE (hand-computed from XML using the GST slab rules; round-half-up per component). Company state 29. LEDGER closings: Acme 11800 Dr; Walk-in Local 5900 Dr; Walk-in Mumbai 236000 Dr; Domestic Sales 215000 Cr; Output CGST 1350 Cr; Output SGST 1350 Cr; Output IGST 36000 Cr. TB Dr = 11800+5900+236000 = 253700; Cr = 215000+1350+1350+36000 = 253700 (balanced). P&L Income 215000, Expense 0, NetProfit 215000. BS Assets (debtors) 253700; Liabilities = CGST 1350 + SGST 1350 + IGST 36000 + NetProfit 215000 = 253700 (balanced). GSTR-1 TaxTotals: CGST 900+450=1350, SGST 900+450=1350, IGST 36000; taxable 10000+5000+200000=215000. HSN (all 18%, hsn blank in Phase1 rollup): one row 215000/1350/1350/36000. B2CS INTRA/29@18: 5000/450/450/0. B2B 29ABCDE1234F1Z5@18: 10000/900/900/0. (S-3 is B2CL: its IGST 36000 lands in TaxTotals.IGST + HSN but B2CL is not asserted per-section here.) GSTR-1 Balanced (return == output-tax postings): true. GSTR-3B (hand-derived from the SAME XML, independently of the GSTR-1 block and of any generated output): 3.1(a) outward taxable supplies = every Sales voucher = taxable 215000, CGST 1350, SGST 1350, IGST 36000; 3.1(d) inward reverse-charge = ZERO (no purchases in this corpus); 3.2 inter-state supplies to UNREGISTERED persons = the single S-3 invoice (Walk-in Mumbai is GSTREGISTRATIONTYPE Consumer, i.e. unregistered, and the supply is inter-state 29->27) = one row POS 27, taxable 200000, IGST 36000; table 4 ITC = ZERO. NOTE (structural, not an omission): NO migration corpus can exercise the 3B ITC or reverse-charge halves, because the Tally importer builds GSTParams only for Sales vouchers (backend/internal/migration/migration.go:514 and :566), so an imported PURCHASE never stamps the voucher_version GST columns. Non-zero ITC/RCM coverage lives in backend/internal/compliance/gstr/gstr3b_integration_test.go, which posts purchases directly through ledger.Service.
